title: A Memorable Experience
description: Tell a connected memorable experience using background, events, and reflection.
objectives: Tell a connected memorable experience using background, events, and reflection.

stages.title: Understand the language
stages.instructions: Read the explanation, examples, common error, and recap.

blocks.text: This lesson prepares you to tell a connected memorable experience using background, events, and reflection. The central language is integrated past and present perfect review. It belongs to the practical context of stories & experiences. Focus first on meaning: decide what information the listener needs. Then choose the subject, verb form, and useful detail. At A2, connect the main message to a time, reason, contrast, or result. Listen for context before choosing the tense or functional phrase. The same language returns in the listening, repeat, speaking, exercises, and guided conversation stages.

blocks.title: Pattern
blocks.text: integrated past and present perfect review

blocks.english: I was studying abroad when I met my best friend.
blocks.explanation: Use this model to begin the a memorable experience exchange.

blocks.english: It was an experience I'll always remember.
blocks.explanation: This a memorable experience model adds a different detail or response.
Use this question or response to keep the a memorable experience exchange moving.

blocks.text: Notice the two models: “I was studying abroad when I met my best friend.” and “It was an experience I'll always remember.” They show the pattern in complete communication, not as isolated grammar. Say the model aloud, replace one detail, and check that the new sentence keeps the intended meaning. When the other person asks a follow-up question, answer directly and add a relevant detail. This makes the exchange natural while keeping the language controlled. Compare the time and viewpoint in each model, and use a linker when two ideas need a clear relationship. Avoid adding advanced forms when the lesson pattern already communicates the message accurately.

blocks.title: Common error
blocks.text: Do not mix the word order or verb form with another pattern. Keep the controlled form for this lesson: integrated past and present perfect review.
